newsitem.title: USA: Goodyear settles suit with Bridgestone.
newsitem.headline: Goodyear settles suit with Bridgestone.

text.p: Goodyear Tire & Rubber Co., the nation's largest tiremaker, has settled its lawsuit challenging rival Bridgestone/Firestone Inc.'s comparative advertising campaign on June 27, the companies said Monday.
The subsidiary of Tokyo-based Bridgestone Corp. agreed to end its national campaign, which compared its FT70c tire to Goodyear's Aquatred II tire, on Sunday.
The companies said they will not disclose other terms of the settlement.

Goodyear, based in Akron, Ohio, said on June 3 that it filed a federal lawsuit against Bridgestone-Firestone, charging that the then two-month-old campaign by the Japanese-owned company constituted false advertising and unfair and deceptive trade practices.
Bridgestone-Firestone is based in Nashville, Tenn.
Goodyear's stock fell 75 cents to $62.50 on the New York Stock Exchange at midday.
